name: Old School Hash Co. Brick Hash | Chem Dawg
description: Our signature Brick Hash, now available in a 2g option and packaged in a sleek, reusable tin—complete with a one hitter pipe for the perfect on-the-go experience. Each brick is pressed from top-grade, solventless sieved resin, delivering a dense, aromatic smoke and that classic, full-bodied hash high.
